answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization involves a combination of generation decisions... We propose HYDRASUM -a new summarization architecture...

answer_2.quote: We report the ROUGE scores of the generated summaries... Additionally, we report coverage, density, 2-gram overlap, specificity (Speciteller), length metrics and Flesch readability scores.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation... we present MTurk workers with 5 different generated summaries... Workers were asked to rate each summary along 4 dimensions: relevance, coherence, grammatically and factuality.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each summary on relevance, coherence, grammaticality, and factuality (binary factual/non‑factual).
